source: federalreserve.gov FOMC meeting schedule (manually curated — official meeting END dates)
_note: Maintain by hand from https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm — keep at least the next 1-2 meetings ahead so the manifest stays READY (a past next_meeting_at => stale => degraded). After EVERY meeting, update last_rate AND bump rate_as_of to that date — the manifest refuses (decision_not_refreshed) when rate_as_of predates the latest decision.
